page: Microsoft Azure EC64eds_v5 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECEDV5 family. It is configured with 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server includes 2891 GB of local SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no onboard graphics processing units, as the GPU count is zero.

From a resource density perspective, the high memory-to-core ratio and large bundled local storage provide qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring substantial memory footprints without the need for external storage attachments. However, the lack of dedicated GPU hardware limits its utility for accelerated computing tasks. The hardware configuration is designed for memory-intensive workloads, database management, and large-scale data processing.
